The projects-sync CI job runs scripts/sync-projects.mjs every 6 h, and the documented manual refresh is `node scripts/sync-projects.mjs --public` (README); every network refresh, scheduled or local, must pass validate() before it can touch this file.

projects.name: MuniDgoSaaS
projects.title: Turnos App
projects.description: Multi-tenant appointment booking for the different areas of my town's municipality: a portal for residents and an admin panel with live validation and ECharts metrics.
projects.problem: One municipality, several areas, no shared place to take appointments.
projects.outcome: Flask and React on MySQL: live validation, a dashboard, and ECharts.

projects.name: OpenBalance
projects.title: OpenBalance
projects.description: It came out of a need of my own: a budget that runs by the month, with an optional weekly mode for anyone paid by the week.
projects.problem: Most budgeting apps hide the month behind a week-based model.
projects.outcome: Local-first Next.js with Zustand persistence and no backend.

projects.name: MyrkStudio
projects.title: Myrk Studio
projects.description: Site for a studio that makes Minecraft series, with 3D scenes in Three.js.
projects.problem: A fictional series needed a site that felt like a studio, not a template.
projects.outcome: React, Vite, and Tailwind with GSAP and Three, tuned for mobile scroll.
